remarks: Project limits are conservative against the code
text: Behaviour factors: the ductility level shall be high for all lateral load resisting systems of power block structures; the response modification factor R and the overstrength factor D shall be taken from TBDY 2018 for the chosen system, with R limited to 6 for steel structures of the power block and to 5 for reinforced concrete frames without shear walls (project limit to keep drift under control), and R = 1.5 for non-building structures that are inverted-pendulum or that have no redundancy (stack, tanks on ring walls per the tank code).
